summary: Where a path-scoped rule mentions a path-scoped skill, an advisory judges the rule's globs against the skill's own paths so the two triggers of one area cannot drift apart
acceptance: a rule whose globs differ from its mentioned skill's paths draws one advisory; equal sets are silent; cargo test green
tests: a rule whose globs are narrower than its mentioned skills paths draws the trigger agreement advisory
pins: a rule whose globs equal its mentioned skills paths draws no trigger agreement advisory
notes: mention-reachable already indicts a rule scope outside the skill's gate; this adds the converse half (0112, "can drift apart"). Reuse its structural subset test, not a second glob comparer.
